name: familial encephalopathy with neuroserpin inclusion bodies
description: A neurodegenerative disease that is characterized by intraneuronal inclusions of mutant neuroserpin resulting in progressive encephalopathy, dementia and seizures and has material basis in a mutation in the SERPINI1 gene inherited in an in autosomal dominant pattern.
